acceptance_criteria: vendor/bin/phpunit is green on PHP 8.4 with the current phpstan/phpstan 2.x release.
Every rule class in src/voku/PHPStan/Rules/ has at least one test asserting that valid code produces no error.
Every rule class has its error identifier asserted.
rules.neon is loaded and every declared service is asserted to be registered.
behavior_anchors: PHP source fixture + rule configuration -> exact PHPStan RuleError list (message, line, identifier)
goal: Replace the thin happy-path PHPUnit coverage of voku/phpstan-rules with a regression-grade suite: no-false-positive fixtures per rule, asserted error identifiers, both states of every configuration flag, rules.neon service wiring, and a fix for the expectations that are already red against the current PHPStan 2.x.
non_goals: Changing rule behaviour in src/ beyond what a proven test failure demands.
